packages.selection_reason: package files changed since the start of history and produced a release bump

changes.message:
chore: scaffold monorepo workspace, tooling, and CI

- uv workspace with three components: observe-core, phlo-observe, phlo-observer
- mise-pinned Python 3.12 and uv toolchain
- prek pre-commit hooks: ruff check/format, ty check, uv lock check
- GitHub Actions CI: quality, per-component tests with Postgres, package
  builds, observer image build + smoke, dependency audit
- Apache-2.0 license, compose dev environment, mkdocs scaffold

feat: implement observe-core event pipeline and drains

Canonical event envelope with JSON Schemas, observe() sync/async context
manager and decorator, contextvars-based correlation propagation, bounded
queue with backpressure policies, deterministic sampling, recursive
redaction, console/JSONL/HTTP/OTLP/memory drains, critical-event spool
with replay, typed OBSERVE_* configuration, and internal health counters.

Includes 131 tests covering lifecycle, context isolation, redaction,
sampling, queue policies, drains, spool, schema conformance, and the
stdlib logging bridge.

feat: implement phlo-observer ingestion, persistence, and query service

FastAPI service that receives canonical events plus Dagster/dbt/generic/OTLP
source payloads, preserves raw payloads in Postgres, normalizes via a pluggable
adapter registry, correlates events into run projections, and serves filtered
event/run/timeline queries.

- canonical /v1/events ingestion: single, batch, gzip, size + batch limits
- idempotent event_id handling: identical resubmission deduped, divergent
  resubmission rejected as INTEGRITY_CONFLICT
- adapter registry: canonical, dagster, dbt run_results/artifacts, generic
- deterministic correlation (explicit run_id, trace_id linking) and
  incremental run projections surviving late-arriving events
- token auth (ingest/read sets, _FILE secret variants, dev-mode fallback)
- /healthz, /readyz with schema version, /metrics with spec metric names
- hourly retention sweep honoring raw/event/run retention settings
- Alembic migration 0001 (async engine) + CLI: serve/migrate/downgrade/
  check/config
- optional OTLP forwarding, Dockerfile (non-root, slim), compose fix
- 39 Postgres-backed tests: auth, ingestion, idempotency, conflicts, gzip,
  limits, filters, pagination, timeline, late events, retention, migrations
- docs: architecture, event-model, configuration, integrations, deployment,
  troubleshooting

feat: add observe replay-spool CLI command

Replays a local critical-event spool directory into the first configured
drain, closing remaining spec coverage for operational spool recovery.

fix: harden observer ingestion, auth, and spec compliance for V1

Correctness:
- per-item canonical validation; malformed events reject 4xx, never 500
- race-safe run upsert with row locks; no lost counter updates
- ended_at only on real terminal outcomes; late signals cannot downgrade
- correlation failures after durable event writes are contained
- controlled 400s for bad cursors, date filters, event ids, adapter payloads
- bulk event insert + batched run pre-creation (~10k/s canonical ingest)

Security:
- *_FILE secret variants honored in the serve path; require_tokens() wired
- hard bounds on wire and decompressed request bodies
- bounded metrics route labels (no attacker-controlled cardinality)
- segment-aware secret key redaction with a bounded verdict cache
- observe config masks drain secrets; replay-spool targets remote drains only
- self-observation rejects http drains (no self-ingest loop)

Spec gaps closed:
- /health/live, /health/ready (+ /healthz, /readyz aliases)
- /v1/assets|branches|tables/{name}/events scoped queries (path converter)
- timeline carries observer-owned labels, summaries, phases, steps
- configure_phlo() SDK entry point; keystone example uses observe-core only
- phlo-observer replay-spool command
- release-please + wheel/image release workflows; real dependency-scan gate
- drop_oldest preserves flush/shutdown control sentinels
- performance suite covers all eight spec benchmarks

Docs and compose/collector configs updated to match actual behavior.

fix: retention cascade, real OTLP forwarding, stricter auth checks

- events.raw_event_id gets ON DELETE SET NULL (migration 0002): raw
  payloads expire (14d) before the events that reference them (90d), so
  the retention sweep's raw_events DELETE hit the FK and rolled back the
  entire cleanup transaction on every pass. The regression test now
  links an event to the expired raw row.
- forward_events now speaks OTLP/HTTP JSON: canonical events are
  exported as resourceLogs log records to the collector's /v1/logs
  endpoint (bare base URLs get the path appended). It is scheduled as a
  fire-and-forget background task instead of being awaited in the
  ingest path, forwards only events that were actually persisted, and
  pending forwards get a bounded drain at shutdown.
- AUTH_OPTIONAL_DEV=false now requires both ingest and read tokens; a
  partially configured token set is not a hardened deployment.
- Readiness also reports a stopped observe-core worker runtime
  (Runtime.workers_alive()).
- Event responses include the stored canonical payload so envelope
  extensions (correlation.extra and top-level extras) are reachable via
  the query API.

fix: stop silent critical-event loss and spool replay stalls

Critical events could be silently dropped under drop_oldest queue
pressure and one permanently-rejected spool segment blocked replay of
all later segments forever. Also fixes dead config/API surface, broken
docs, and spec gaps found in review.

observe-core:
- drop_oldest evicts the oldest non-critical event first; an evicted
  critical goes to the spool instead of counting a drop
- control sentinels (_FlushRequest/_STOP) are never evicted; held items
  that fail re-queue under contention are spooled (critical) or counted
- spool replay seals the active segment first, skips segments still
  open for write, and takes a non-blocking replay lock
- PermanentDrainFailure quarantines poison segments as .dead so
  transient failures keep segments but permanent ones cannot stall
  replay head-of-line; malformed segments quarantine as .corrupt
- quarantined files count toward max_bytes and are evictable so a
  poison flood cannot grow the spool unboundedly
- wire HttpDrainConfig.spool_on_failure; non-retryable 4xx raises
  PermanentDrainFailure; OtlpDrain treats unparseable replay payloads
  as permanent
- worker loop survives drain exceptions beyond Exception
- per-operation capture_stacktrace override on observe()/event()
- JsonlDrain writes/flushes under a lock for multi-worker safety
- operation duration reconciled against wall clock so envelope
  invariants hold when the clock shifts

phlo-observer:
- real OTLP adapter: one canonical event per logRecord with severity,
  correlation, service, and attribute mapping; /v1/ingest/otlp routes
  to it
- store_raw honors adapter keep_payload, caps payload size
  (PHLO_OBSERVER_MAX_RAW_PAYLOAD_BYTES) with SHA-256 digest fallback,
  and retains X-Source-Version
- X-Run-Id / X-Trace-Id / X-Request-Id / X-Asset-Key ingestion headers
  feed RawPayload.metadata; generic adapter merges transport metadata
  and body fields so external events correlate into runs
- phlo_observer_queue_depth gauge now reflects the self-observation
  queue at scrape time
- timeline output bounded at 10,000 events with a truncated flag
- PHLO_OBSERVER_DATABASE_URL_FILE precedence fixed so explicit
  constructor args are not silently overridden

sdk + docs + tests:
- phlo-observe[dbt] extra; docs now reference the real SDK API and
  event names
- sanitized fixtures + golden canonical events for all adapters
- failure-injection tests: db down/reconnect, drain exceptions in the
  worker, shutdown with queued events; regression tests for every fix

fix: correlation inheritance, env list parsing, and ingest status accounting

- event() inside an observe() block now inherits run_id/trace_id/span
  coordinates from the active operation context (precedence: explicit >
  operation > ambient); CorrelationFilter uses the same effective set.
- error.details are normalized like attributes so one unserializable
  detail cannot drop a critical event.
- OBSERVE_*/PHLO_OBSERVER_* list settings accept comma-separated or JSON
  values via NoDecode, and _FILE token variants no longer double-count
  the plain env value.
- Invalid configuration renders an operator-facing message (env var
  name, received value with secrets masked, docs pointer) instead of a
  raw ValidationError traceback, in both CLIs.
- raw.normalization_status and the ingest batch metric now reflect
  persist-stage rejections; readiness reports schema_incompatible
  instead of a 500 when the events schema is missing.
- OTLP drain attributes move to the observe.* namespace so core stays
  generic.
- correlation_method counts trace_id correlations once.

fix: provision the test database in compose and drop dead rotation branch

docker compose postgres now creates phlo_observer_test via initdb, so the
observer, integration and performance suites run against the default URL
(localhost:5432/phlo_observer_test) with no manual setup — matching CI and
CONTRIBUTING. JsonlDrain._rotate loses the unreachable unlink branch.

fix: restore OTLP round-trip fidelity and close fail-open gaps

- emit() re-raises TelemetryError even when fail_fast is off, so
  telemetry_required actually fails closed on oversized events instead
  of silently dropping them
- add observe_core.otlp_mapping: one shared canonical-event <-> OTLP
  attribute encoder used by the OTLP drain and the observer forwarder
- OTLP ingest adapter restores observe.*-encoded records (marked by
  observe.event_id) to their original envelope: event id/name,
  correlation incl. run/trace ids and extra, timing, severity, service,
  error and source; plain OTel records keep the generic mapping
- @observe wraps sync and async generators so the operation spans the
  whole iteration and mid-iteration failures emit failure events
- _evict_oldest_event drains the queue and re-queues survivors in
  original order; oldest critical is removed by identity
- readyz probes the events table with SELECT ... LIMIT 1 instead of
  count(*), and drops the events_stored field
- adapters (canonical, dagster, dbt, generic, otlp) report per-record
  normalization errors against original source positions via
  NormalizedBatch.indices; persist_events maps them back and guards
  against index-length mismatches
- parse Content-Encoding case-insensitively and per-token for gzip
- _dagster_asset_key returns None for callable values instead of
  stringifying a bound method
- phlo-observer depends on observe-core[otlp] so the self-observe OTLP
  drain works in the shipped environment; LogRecord now imports from
  opentelemetry._logs (moved in OTel SDK 1.44)
- drop the unused session_scope helper
- document the observe.* OTLP attribute mapping in integrations.md
  (spec section 13.4)
- tests: oversized-event raise, generator decorators, eviction order,
  OTLP drain record, mapping unit tests, OTLP ingest round-trip golden
  + end-to-end run correlation, per-item adapter errors, and the
  redaction legs for the HTTP and spool sinks (spec section 16)

chore: switch release automation from release-please to ReleaseX

- relx.toml: monorepo per_package mode for observe-core, phlo-observe and
  phlo-observer; independent <package>/v<version> tags and release PRs
- release-python workflow: relx status gate on main pushes, release pr
  for pending packages, release tag on merged chore(release) commits
- release-observer workflow: trigger on phlo-observer/v* tags and derive
  the image tag from the version component
- drop release-please config/manifest; reset package baselines to 0.0.0
  so the first release PRs ship 0.1.0

fix: keep observer image smoke green and pin ReleaseX action

- runtime: degrade to spool=None when the spool directory cannot be
  created instead of crashing startup (unwritable home in the non-root
  image made every boot fail before serving liveness)
- Dockerfile: create /var/lib/phlo-observe owned by the observer user and
  point OBSERVE_SPOOL_DIR at it
- release-python: pin iamgp/ReleaseX to v1.9.4 (no floating v1 tag)

(localhost:5432/phlo_observer_test) with no manual setup — matching CI and
CONTRIBUTING. JsonlDrain._rotate loses the unreachable unlink branch.

fix: restore OTLP round-trip fidelity and close fail-open gaps

- emit() re-raises TelemetryError even when fail_fast is off, so
  telemetry_required actually fails closed on oversized events instead
  of silently dropping them
- add observe_core.otlp_mapping: one shared canonical-event <-> OTLP
  attribute encoder used by the OTLP drain and the observer forwarder
- OTLP ingest adapter restores observe.*-encoded records (marked by
  observe.event_id) to their original envelope: event id/name,
  correlation incl. run/trace ids and extra, timing, severity, service,
  error and source; plain OTel records keep the generic mapping
- @observe wraps sync and async generators so the operation spans the
  whole iteration and mid-iteration failures emit failure events
- _evict_oldest_event drains the queue and re-queues survivors in
  original order; oldest critical is removed by identity
- readyz probes the events table with SELECT ... LIMIT 1 instead of
  count(*), and drops the events_stored field
- adapters (canonical, dagster, dbt, generic, otlp) report per-record
  normalization errors against original source positions via
  NormalizedBatch.indices; persist_events maps them back and guards
  against index-length mismatches
- parse Content-Encoding case-insensitively and per-token for gzip
- _dagster_asset_key returns None for callable values instead of
  stringifying a bound method
- phlo-observer depends on observe-core[otlp] so the self-observe OTLP
  drain works in the shipped environment; LogRecord now imports from
  opentelemetry._logs (moved in OTel SDK 1.44)
- drop the unused session_scope helper
- document the observe.* OTLP attribute mapping in integrations.md
  (spec section 13.4)
- tests: oversized-event raise, generator decorators, eviction order,
  OTLP drain record, mapping unit tests, OTLP ingest round-trip golden
  + end-to-end run correlation, per-item adapter errors, and the
  redaction legs for the HTTP and spool sinks (spec section 16)

chore: switch release automation from release-please to ReleaseX

- relx.toml: monorepo per_package mode for observe-core, phlo-observe and
  phlo-observer; independent <package>/v<version> tags and release PRs
- release-python workflow: relx status gate on main pushes, release pr
  for pending packages, release tag on merged chore(release) commits
- release-observer workflow: trigger on phlo-observer/v* tags and derive
  the image tag from the version component
- drop release-please config/manifest; reset package baselines to 0.0.0
  so the first release PRs ship 0.1.0

fix: keep observer image smoke green and pin ReleaseX action

- runtime: degrade to spool=None when the spool directory cannot be
  created instead of crashing startup (unwritable home in the non-root
  image made every boot fail before serving liveness)
- Dockerfile: create /var/lib/phlo-observe owned by the observer user and
  point OBSERVE_SPOOL_DIR at it
- release-python: pin iamgp/ReleaseX to v1.9.4 (no floating v1 tag)
